OZE Book Reader

Before the kids start

1. Set a parent PIN below, so kids cannot change settings or leave kid mode. 2. Pick the storyteller voice and speed below. 3. Tap Start kid mode when you hand the phone over. For a full phone lockdown as well, use Android screen pinning: recents screen, tap the app icon, Pin.

Make a story with your name

Type a name, pick a mate, and it makes a new story just for them, pixel art on every page. One at a time; make a new one to replace it.

Add your own story

Load a story file (.json) or paste one in. Stories are saved on this device only.

How to make a story file 
Story file format (save as my-story.json):

{
 "title": "My New Story",
 "pages": [
  {"n":1, "t":"Page title",
   "lines":["One short sentence.","Another one."]},
  {"n":2, "t":"A choice page",
   "lines":["What happens next?"],
   "choices":[["Go left",3],["Go right",4]]},
  {"n":3, "t":"The end",
   "lines":["They all lived happily."],
   "ending":true}
 ],
 "images": { "key": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..." }
}

Put "img":"key" on a page to show a picture. Use the Save story file button on any book to see a real example.

Recordings on this device

Recordings live only on this device. Save a voice pack to move them to another phone (for example, a copy for someone special), then load it there. Turning the default voice on makes your saved library narrate any story.

Parent lock

Works with no internet and nothing you do in it is sent anywhere.

Activate your copy

Step 1: tap the button below to send your device code to OZEworks (with your payment done).
